stories.summary: President Lai Ching-te led Lunar New Year prayers at Longshan Temple, visited Coast Guard stations, and delivered New Year messages emphasizing Taiwan's defense strengthening and economic development. stories.headline: Taiwan and US sign major trade agreement with tariff reductions
stories.summary: Taiwan and the United States signed the Agreement on Reciprocal Trade (ART) in Washington, reducing average tariffs on US exports from 35.7% to 12.33%. The deal includes exemptions for 2,072 Taiwanese export products and establishes a framework for expanded economic cooperation.

stories.headline: Lai administration toughens stance on transnational repression
stories.summary: President Lai Ching-te's administration has implemented stricter controls on capital flows from China and enhanced protections for Hong Kong political refugees in Taiwan. The policy shift aims to counter Chinese transnational repression activities targeting Hong Kong activists.
